tickets.title: Prepare month-by-month tuition funding schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month schedule for Mira Quillwhistle showing the allocation of Marzipan Meadow College charges among the Elin 529 at Velvet Acorn Custody, the $21,000 tuition set-aside at Teacup Comet Bank, and the Paper Otter Treasury reserve, assuming retirement contributions remain unchanged.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule, dated December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain official Marzipan Meadow billing packet
tickets.text: Obtain the itemized student account PDF for Marzipan Meadow College billing packet for Mira Quillwhistle to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain the packet, dated December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Reconcile Velvet Acorn 529 balance discrepancy
tickets.text: Reconcile the reported $67,400 balance in Elin Quillwhistle’s 529 at Velvet Acorn Custody with the $72,270 statement amount to determine the correct funds available for upcoming tuition payments for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to reconcile the balance discrepancy, dated December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify direct payment workflow for college portal
tickets.text: Identify an acceptable direct-payment or reimbursement workflow for Mira Quillwhistle to resolve the college portal’s rejection of the 529 bank verification and enable tuition funding.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to identify the workflow, dated December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection for Rowan Quillwhistle using the existing 529 balance at Velvet Acorn Custody, anticipated test and application costs, and a first-year college savings target that avoids borrowing, for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection, dated December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare off-campus housing cost projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection for Elin Quillwhistle’s off-campus apartment rent, food, and utility expenses to assess fit within the education funding plan versus parent cash flow for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection, dated January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare scholarship aid cost-gap estimate
tickets.text: Prepare an estimate of the cost gap for Rowan Quillwhistle based on the scholarship response calendar to compare merit aid offers before the first school deposit decision for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the estimate, dated February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare tax estimate and sale-sequencing review
tickets.text: Prepare a tax estimate and sale-sequencing review for the Paper Otter taxable account’s education reserve, evaluating unrealized gains and the Treasury position to determine tax implications before using the funds for tuition for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the tax estimate and sale-sequencing review, dated January 3, 2024.
